entries.26742ef800ee5725: Its basic principle is "Contributing to the international community and achieving sustained growth by earning customer satisfaction through technological capability and action," and its policy, built on respect for humanity and the pursuit of rationality, is to turn original ideas into products through challenges with new technologies. The medium-term management plan "3 Years of Leaping and Growing" (fiscal years ended December 2023 to December 2025) set "development of new products and new businesses," "strengthening manufacturing capability and productivity," "human resource development" and "efforts toward carbon neutrality" as priority issues, and the company has advanced application development in the thermal transfer media field, environmentally oriented technology development, and expansion of elemental technologies through industry-academia collaboration with universities. During the plan period, the company states that a lack of momentum persisted due to sluggish markets in China and Europe and delays in launching development themes, and it cites as challenges reviewing strategies and tactics in response to changes in the market environment and optimizing the allocation of management resources.
